HDB and condo owners thinking of upgrading to a New Launch Condo: Read this first👇
If you’re planning to upgrade, the biggest risk isn’t the market.
It’s making the move without clarity 🤔

Most homeowners focus on the next property.
What really matters is how you sell, what you buy, and how you structure the upgrade 🧠

Get it wrong, and one decision can set your finances back years 💸
Get it right, and upgrading can genuinely build long-term wealth 📈

But at Damien Tan Real Estate, we've helped owners achieve 19.84% annual returns (on average) after upgrading.

Here’s what they did differently:
✅ They didn’t sell at whatever the agent quoted, they waited for the real ceiling price
✅ They didn’t buy the flashiest project, they bought the one positioned to appreciate
✅ They used data to structure the upgrade without over-leveraging

That’s exactly what our Triple Funnel System does. And we’ll apply it to your property - for free:

✅ Exit current home at record prices 
✅ Choose New Launch Projects that actually hold value 
✅ Preserve cash and future flexibility 

This is the same approach that’s helped 800+ families upgrade confidently
without guessing or over-stretching 🏠
